items.title: Two hitherto unknown Indonesian tsunamis of the seventeenth century: Probabilities and context
items.note: Shows that Dutch and Malay texts can yield otherwise unknown tsunamis, a method model for searching earlier sources for the Aceh events.

items.title: High-frequency Coastal Overwash Deposits from Phra Thong Island, Thailand
items.note: Ground-penetrating radar and trenching on Phra Thong Island find more frequent overwash layers than the four-event medieval record had suggested.

items.title: Highly variable recurrence of tsunamis in the 7,400 years before the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami
items.who: C. M. Rubin, B. P. Horton, K. Sieh et al.
items.note: Coastal cave deposits in Aceh record at least 11 tsunamis between 7,400 and 2,900 years ago, with intervals from a century to over 2,000 years.

items.title: The Historic Trading Port of Lamri on the North Sumatran Coast
items.who: P. Daly, E. E. McKinnon, R. M. Feener et al.
items.note: Describes the Lamreh site and argues for its identification with the port of Lamri known from Arabic, Chinese and Malay references.

items.title: Archaeological evidence that a late 14th-century tsunami devastated the coast of northern Sumatra and redirected history
items.who: P. Daly, K. Sieh, T. Y. Seng et al.
items.note: Survey of ceramics and over 5,000 gravestones along 40 km of the Aceh coast dates the destruction of nine settlements to about 1394, sparing hilltop Lamri.

items.title: An Investigation of Archaeological Remains at Lamreh Site, Aceh, Indonesia and Their Context Within the Lamuri Kingdom
items.venue: International Journal of Asia Pacific Studies
items.note: Records 15th-century plak-pling gravestones, imported ceramics, glass and Chinese coins at Lamreh, including an inscription naming a possible Lamuri official.

items.title: Tsunami records of the last 8000 years in the Andaman Island, India, from mega and large earthquakes: Insights on recurrence interval
items.note: Sand sheets on southern Andaman Island include a tsunami dated 1300–1400 CE, extending the footprint of the late medieval event north along the 2004 rupture.

items.title: The impact of Ming and Qing dynasty maritime bans on trade ceramics recovered from coastal settlements in northern Sumatra, Indonesia
items.who: Y. S. Tai, P. Daly, E. E. McKinnon et al.
items.note: Shows Chinese ceramics in Aceh fell during the 1371–1509 Ming ban, with Burmese and Thai wares substituting; relevant to reading silence in Chinese texts.

items.title: Segmentation and supercycles: A catalog of earthquake rupture patterns from the Sumatran Sunda Megathrust and other well-studied faults worldwide
items.who: B. Philibosian and A. J. Meltzner
items.note: Compiles paleogeodetic and historical rupture histories for the Sunda megathrust and other faults, the framework into which the Aceh–Andaman events are placed.

items.title: Islamisation and the formation of vernacular Muslim material culture in 15th-century northern Sumatra
items.who: R. M. Feener, P. Daly, E. E. McKinnon et al.
items.note: Typology of over 200 plak-pling gravestones with dated Arabic inscriptions, tying them to early 15th-century Lamri; gives dated epigraphy for the post-1394 period.

items.title: Gempa Nusantara: A Database of 7380 Macroseismic Observations for 1200 Historical Earthquakes in Indonesia from 1546 to 1950
items.who: S. S. Martin, P. R. Cummins, A. J. Meltzner
items.venue: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
items.note: Systematic text-derived catalogue of Indonesian earthquakes and tsunamis; begins in 1546, so it models the kind of search needed but does not reach the windows.

items.title: Sedimentological observations and geochemical characteristics of paleo-tsunami deposits along the east coast of Sri Lanka in the Indian Ocean
items.note: Characterises paleotsunami sand layers on Sri Lanka's east coast, one of the far-field coasts where a trans-basin wave of the 1390s or 1450s should register.

items.title: Insights into tectonic hazards since the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
items.who: G. M. Sarkawi, L. Feng, J. W. McCaughey, A. J. Meltzner
items.note: Twenty-year review of geological and geodetic work since 2004, including the evidence for the 2004 rupture's predecessors.

items.title: A 7500-year paleotsunami record from the coastal sediment of Sri Lanka and Indian Ocean trans-basin tsunami history
items.who: P. N. Ranasinghe, J. D. Ortiz, A. Moore et al.
items.note: Unreviewed preprint presenting a long Sri Lankan paleotsunami sequence correlated with events across the basin.
